value.rationale: The exponent min(m,S-m) is a sharp structural classification of accessibility barriers for correlated multiagent search: higher powers occur for balanced reset partitions, across every connected bipartite graph. On star graphs the exact hub encounter mean is leaf-count invariant and has a unique finite optimal independent holding probability, distinguishing no movement, perfect synchrony and useful weak asynchrony. This is a natural motivated transport optimization rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
